title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
abstract: arXiv:2611.21565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain prediction

translated_title: 何时需要为组织学基础模型引入几何测试时增强？
translated_abstract: 测试时增强（TTA）在推理阶段对输入图像的多个变换视图聚合模型预测。由于组织学图像缺乏标准的方向性，D₄ TTA——即对正方形的8种旋转和反射进行池化——一直是计算病理学中的标准默认做法。然而，具有固有旋转不变性的自监督组织学基础模型（FMs）的兴起，使这种做法的持续有效性受到质疑。我们在四个补丁级数据集和两个全切片图像（WSI）数据集上，对9个组织学基础模型和6个通用模型进行了基准测试。我们发现，D₄ TTA 仍然是一种可靠的事后改进手段，但其收益从通用骨干网络的 +1.98 个百分点（pp）下降到组织学基础模型在 TCGA-UT 上的 +0.50 个百分点，并且对于最大的模型收益进一步缩小。为了消除计算开销，我们的实验表明，熵路由——即仅对不确定的预测选择性地应用 TTA——（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 组织学基础模型因自身已具备旋转不变性，从几何测试时增强中获得的收益远小于通用模型，而熵路由可在保留收益的同时选择性应用TTA以消除计算开销。
en_tdlr: Histology foundation models, being inherently rotation-invariant, gain far less from geometric test-time augmentation than general-purpose models, and entropy routing can retain the benefits while eliminating computational overhead by applying TTA only to uncertain predictions.
